You correct the issue and ensure that the batch matches the prescribed order. Finally, you make sure the batches are packaged and prepared for shipment. Throughout the entire process, strict quality standards apply because you are working with pharmaceutical products; precision and accuracy are therefore very important. You will manage late arrivals, early departures, and overnight guest requests, while maintaining a calm, organised front desk environment.This role is key in ensuring guest satisfaction, safety, and operational continuity throughout the night.The position offers a minimum of 15 hours per week, making it ideal for those seeking flexibility or a part-time schedule.Responsibilities• Ensure a smooth overnight operation of the Front Office, maintaining a safe and welcoming environment• Manage late check-ins, early check-outs, and all guest requests during the night shift• Handle administrative tasks such as night auditing, reporting, and system updates accurately• Respond to guest inquiries across phone, email, and face-to-face communication• Maintain professional communication with guests and colleagues to ensure seamless service• Monitor hotel security and safety procedures in line with brand standards• Collaborate with housekeeping and other departments to prepare for the next day's operationsEssential Requirements• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)• Ability to work independently and remain calm during night shifts• Highly organised with strong attention to detail• Responsible and proactive mindset with a focus on guest experience• Eligible to work in the NetherlandsPreferred Requirements• Previous experience in Front Office or night audit roles• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)• Basic accounting or reporting experience is an advantage• Dutch or any additional
